releases.title: Real opponent play and fair wins
notes: Online: you now see how the other player really plays their side - their presses, hits, misses and holds (no more bot playing for them)
Their ratings and misses pop up over their arrows, and their voice cuts out when they miss
The health bar is now a tug of war: your hits pull it to your side, their hits pull it back
Fair winner: better accuracy wins (then fewer misses), even if one side of the song has more notes
The results screen shows why you won or lost
Faster and more reliable online messages between players
Both players need 1.1.8 to play online together

releases.title: New icon and title fix
notes: The title screen logo is no longer cut off at the top left (wide phones, mods)
New FNF Mic Link app icon
Game folder messages fixed, the old folder is now moved completely
Credits: FNF Mic Link, creator of the online mode (Telegram channel)

releases.title: In-game updates
notes: A red icon in the main menu now shows when a new version is out
Tap it to see what's new and update the game in one tap
Downloads continue after a lost connection and are checked before installing
Tap the version text in the main menu to see what's new

releases.title: New app ID
notes: The app ID is now com.fnfmiclink.psych
It installs next to older builds: remove the old app after installing
Settings start fresh, your mods are kept

releases.title: New game folder
notes: The game folder is now "FNF Mic Link Psych"
Your mods and received songs are moved there automatically

releases.title: New name
